Added four independent synthetic coordinate checks on unequal oblique fixed/moving/work grids with nonidentity arm affines/residuals: image/arm swap reverses symmetric derivative and preserves opposite candidate losses; rigid rotations and handedness reversal preserve objective and transform spatial covectors for both actions; full frozen CC finite differences match the spatial chain for symmetric/fixed-anchor actions; active boundary derivatives stay explicitly unavailable. All 13 focused JVM and 13 Scala.js tests pass, plus two runner tests and four Python ledger/verdict tests. Initial sbt sandbox-lock and wrong-interpreter missing-nibabel failures retained; no tolerance change.

Frozen and launched three-state acquired-image role-swap study: OASIS11 coarse end, OASIS13 fine end, MMRR11 fine start. Source 890f7b4d221d2091b1c30091f36e46c8ee86f559a908a148593a3dc8ebcc64c3 changes only the new RealImageOrderAudit runner and synthetic suite relative to the pyramid engine; kernels/optimizer unchanged. Original full audits must reproduce exactly. Three directions, two epsilons and both signs produce 12 opposite-signed candidate pairs per state. Frozen loss tolerance 1e-12, gradient antisymmetry max-absolute 1e-11/relative-L2 1e-10, complete swapped support and identical validity required. All states/failures retained; no policy added. Image validity remains attached to its image, including the original fixed fitting mask; this is a private same-work-grid probe, NOT reverse fitting or reference-grid exchange. Declaration archive exists before execution at docs/benchmarks/evidence/halfflow-coordinate-audit-20261014/declaration-v1; report docs/benchmarks/halfflow-coordinate-audit-v1.md. Acquired-image outcomes pending; D01/D02 remain open.
